entries.label: Version 1
entries.prompt:
Redesign the existing Funds Manager personal-finance web app. SAME product behaviour and information architecture — only the visual design and polish change. Output interactive HTML prototypes (multi-file ok) that a developer can implement in React+Tailwind later.

## Product (do not change behaviour)
Self-hosted AU personal finance SPA (no login). Import bank PDF statements, categorise transactions, cash-flow dashboard, net worth, broker serviceability / living expenses / printable reports.

## Navigation IA (keep labels + grouping exactly)
Left sidebar brand "FUNDS":
- Overview: Dashboard, Breakdown, Future predictions
- Cash flow: Transactions, Income, Living expenses, Serviceability, Report snapshots, Repeat payments, Planned spending
- Net worth: Accounts, Assets, Liabilities
- Data & setup: Statements, Categories, Settings

Attention badges can appear on Transactions and Planned spending.

## Screens to design (priority)
1. Dashboard — title "Spending & Income Overview"; account filter + period segmented control (This month / 3 months / 6 months / 1 year / All time); 4 KPI cards (Current Balance, Spending, Income, Net) with vs-prior deltas; monthly Receiving vs Spending bar chart; Spending by Category + Income by Category donuts ("Click a slice to see transactions"); balance-over-time / net-worth charts below.
2. Transactions — dense paginated table; filters: account, search descriptions, All|Uncategorized, Hide transfers; actions Recategorize uncategorized / New category; columns: checkbox, Date, Account, Description, Amount (signed colour), Balance, Status pill, Category picker with colour dot; pagination footer.
3. Statements — PDF upload/dropzone, statement list, missing-period alerts.
4. Categories — parent/sub tree, colour chips, merge/reorder affordances.
5. Serviceability — income, repayments, living costs, surplus (+ stress scenario).

Use realistic AU dollar sample data similar to: balance ~$15k, spending ~$43k / income ~$52k over 6 months, account "People's Choice 9120", merchant-style descriptions.

## Current look to REPLACE
Dark black/slate glassmorphism, purple (#a287cd) active-nav accent, soft glass cards. Functional but generic AI-dashboard / purple-glow vibe.

## New visual direction
Move away from purple glass. Aim for a calm, precise fintech workspace inspired by Linear-quality density and typography:
- Distinctive but restrained; not marketing-landing, not crypto neon, not purple gradients, not cream+terracotta editorial, not newspaper broadsheet.
- Light OR dark is fine — pick ONE coherent system. Prefer a confident dark charcoal OR warm off-white paper workspace — not both themes in one deliverable.
- Expressive loaded fonts (not Inter/Roboto/system). Clear type hierarchy; tabular numbers for money.
- Sidebar remains primary nav; keep one composition per page; avoid card-for-card's-sake — use surface only when it aids scanning of KPIs/charts/tables.
- Charts: clear, legible, restrained motion (subtle hover only).
- Preserve all interactive affordances (filters, category pickers, upload, badges) as working UI chrome in the prototype (can be static data).

## Deliverables
- Shared tokens (CSS variables) + layout chrome (sidebar + page shell)
- Separate HTML pages or routed views for the 5 priority screens above
- A short README/notes block in the entry file listing what stayed the same behaviour-wise vs what changed visually
- Desktop-first (~1280–1440), usable at ~1024

Do not invent new features or rename nav items. Do not add auth screens.

entries.label: Version 2
entries.prompt:
FEATURE BRANCH — First-time help walkthrough prototype for GitHub #52. Do NOT rewrite dashboard/transactions/statements/categories/serviceability/login layout or shared sidebar chrome beyond minimal data-od / data-tour hooks and a tiny Settings stub link.

## Ticket intent (#52)
New users land with no guidance. Build a first-run tutorial: spotlight/tooltip overlays on REAL UI (not a standalone modal-only tour). Progress step N of M. Skip / dismiss anytime. Esc dismisses. localStorage flag `funds.walkthrough.done` (and Settings "Show tutorial again"). Degrades on narrow viewports.

## Guided steps (exact order)
1. Welcome — one sentence what FUNDS does (self-hosted AU personal finance)
2. Statements — upload bank/credit PDF export (highlight dropzone / upload)
3. Transactions — search, filters, category picker, suggestions/bulk affordances
4. Categories — hierarchy, colours, merge/reorder
5. Dashboard — period filter, KPIs, charts / drill-down hint
6. Breakdown / Recurring — shorter optional stop or "learn more" (can be a compact step on Breakdown stub or dual callouts)

## Visual system
Match THIS project's warm paper / modern-minimal tokens (`css/shared.css`) — IBM Plex, hairline, single blue accent. Not purple glass. (Production ticket mentions dark theme; prototype follows redesign system.)

## Deliverables (NEW files preferred)
1. `css/walkthrough.css` — overlay, spotlight cutout, tooltip card, progress, focus trap styling
2. `js/walkthrough.js` — data-driven steps array (selectors + title + body + page href), localStorage, keyboard (Esc), Skip / Next / Back / Got it, auto-start if flag unset when `?tour=1` OR first visit on index/dashboard
3. Wire minimal `data-tour="..."` attributes onto EXISTING pages only where needed: funds-statements, funds-transactions, funds-categories, funds-dashboard (and a light Breakdown stub page OR step that uses a placeholder panel if Breakdown HTML doesn't exist — create `funds-breakdown.html` minimal stub matching chrome if required for step 6)
4. `funds-walkthrough-demo.html` OR enhance `index.html` with a "First-time walkthrough" launcher that resets the flag and starts the tour
5. Tiny Settings affordance: on index or a one-line note + button "Show tutorial again" that clears the flag

## Behaviour
- Tour navigates between pages as steps advance (or uses in-page multi-scene if cleaner — prefer real page navigation with query `?tour=1&step=N` so each core section is visited)
- Always visible: progress, Skip tutorial, Next
- Don't block forever; overlay allows Esc / Skip
- Copy should be concise, action-oriented

## Out of scope
- Real auth, video, every-page contextual help, server-persisted state
- Rewriting the main redesign screens

When done, list files touched and confirm main screen layouts were not redesigned.

entries.label: Version 4
entries.prompt:
Polish the Transactions page prototype at `funds-transactions.html` for the Funds Manager warm-paper redesign. Match the craft quality of `funds-breakdown.html` and `funds-predictions.html` (flat page header, entity panel, quiet typography, semantic money colours). Use existing shared chrome (`css/shared.css`, `js/shared.js`) and design tokens already in this project.

Update `funds-transactions.html` in place (and add `css/transactions.css` only if needed). Wire sidebar active state for Transactions.

## Must reflect real product behaviour (prototype affordances OK)
- Flat header: title "Transactions", subtitle like "Categorise imports · {account label}", header actions: ghost "Recategorize uncategorized" + ink primary "New category"
- Single panel wrapping toolbar + table + pager
- Toolbar: account select, search descriptions, All | Uncategorized segmented control, hide-transfers toggle switch (not checkbox)
- Data table columns: select, date (mono), account, description (with transfer badge when relevant), amount (semantic green/red from chart palette), balance (mono neutral), status pills (Posted / Needs cat. / Pending), category chip with colour dot + select (show uncategorized warn state)
- Category suggestion row affordance: when uncategorized, show compact "Apply {category}" suggestion chip beside picker (like product)
- Transfer suggestions callout above table when matches exist (out/in legs, confirm/dismiss) — warm-paper alert, not dark blue
- Bulk selection bar when rows checked: count, category picker, apply/clear/suggestion actions
- Pager footer: "Showing 1–25 of N" with Previous/Next ghost buttons

## Visual alignment with recent pages
- Same flat header pattern as predictions (no heavy GlassCard header)
- Panel head optional; prefer clean toolbar row inside panel
- Table header sticky on paper, hairline borders, hover row tint
- Remove any leftover dark-theme or loud styling

## Sample data
Keep realistic AU merchant descriptions, mixed categorized/uncategorized, a few transfers, positive salary rows.

Do not change other pages except sidebar link wiring if needed.
